chunks: Whose kingdom spreads over the heavens and the earth. God is witness over everything.
ai.seo_question: What does it mean that God is the witness over everything in the Quran?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Al-Furat, this verse establishes the foundation of divine authority by linking cosmic sovereignty with intimate omniscience, a theme central to Shia theological discussions on God's attributes (Sifat). It underscores that the same All-Seeing Witness who governs the celestial realms is equally aware of human deeds, reinforcing the concept of divine justice and the inevitability of the Hereafter.
